items.html: And behold, all this is done now in one moment, in the secret of returning light and in haste, immediately after nine years and one day; therefore the minor is now fit for coupling and his intercourse is a valid intercourse, as mentioned. Therefore now begins the education of the minor for the commandment, but not a complete obligation, until the year of thirteen and one day, for then his growth is completed, as will be said with the help of God. And the matter is that all this is done now in one moment.
